scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @resumind/web" "npm run dev -w @resumind/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @resumind/shared && npm run build -w @resumind/ui && npm run build -w @resumind/api && npm run build -w @resumind/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @resumind/shared && npm run build -w @resumind/ui && npm run typecheck -w @resumind/api && npm run typecheck -w @resumind/web
